mechanism: Rulesets map selectors to declarations. Cascade, specificity, inheritance, and then used-value computation produce layout. Recent CSS (grid, alignment, anchor, style queries) is constraint solving, not assignment.
why: Presentation had to be restyled without rewriting documents. Cascading lets user, author, and UA sheets coexist.
useWhen: Layout, theme, responsive design, and any visual constraint that should not be a JS layout loop.
price: Specificity wars; no general computation; debugging computed style is a specialized skill; some layout is still engine-magic.
